newsitem.title: INDIA: India Lakme falls after results.
newsitem.headline: India Lakme falls after results.

text.p: Indian cosmetics firm, Lakme Ltd, lost 37.50 rupees, or nine percent, to 387 on the Bombay bourse on Thursday on the back of poor results for 1996/97 (April-March), traders said.
Lakme announced its results on Wednesday. Its net profit fell to 145.37 million rupees in 1996/97 from 1.08 billion in 1995/96 while sales plunged to 487.74 million from 878.91 million.
"Lakme's results have not been good. The company's marketing agreement with Hindustan Lever Ltd is seen as a sale of its brands," said Kuntal Shah at stock brokerage D.T. Gandhi.

He said that the market was unsure whether Lakme would be able to pass on the price change, resulting from a change in excise duty, to the consumers of its products. "There are better opportunities than Lakme."

At 1.00 p.m. (0730 GMT), 74,700 shares of Lakme had changed hands on the Bombay Stock Exchange. On the National Stock Exchange, the share had lost 29.8 rupees to 396.30, and 72,800 shares had been traded.
